title: Asking for Patience During Trials
arabic: يَا صَبُوْرُ صَبِّرْنِيْ عَلَىٰ مَا بَلَوْتَنِيْ وَامْتَحَنْتَنِيْ
transliteration: Yā Ṣabūru ṣabbirnī ʿalā mā balawatanī wamtaḥantanī
translation: Oh The Most Patient, enable me to be patient upon whatever You afflict and test me with.
reference: A heartfelt supplication asking Allah for patience during trials
